I have resolved the issue in [json.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qmp22uw_/django/db/models/fields/json.py):

- Added [`HasKeyLookup.compile_json_path_final_key`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qmp22uw_/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L175-L177) so that the final key in [`HasKeyLookup.as_sql`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qmp22uw_/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L179-L207) (`has_key`, `has_keys`, and `has_any_keys` on SQLite, MySQL, and Oracle) is compiled as a JSON object key (`.%s` with `json.dumps(key)`) rather than an array index when the key is numeric.
- Added [`HasKeyOrArrayIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qmp22uw_/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L257-L259) for internal use in [`KeyTransformIsNull`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qmp22uw_/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L393-L414) and [`KeyTransformExact.as_oracle`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qmp22uw_/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L471-L483), preserving array index compilation for `KeyTransform` lookups.
